snippet.title: Forever Drive
snippet.description:
OUT NOW ON ANDROID!

From the makers MiniSquadron and EpicWin, Supermono presents FOREVER DRIVE!

Exclusively for iOS and Android devices, Forever Drive is a racing game set in a beautiful 3D futuristic city made, in part, by YOU. Using the BUILT-IN Track Editor, tracks created by different players are joined together into a never-ending road to drive! Customise your car from a huge selection of paintwork and license plates and prepare to drive as far as you can before the clock runs out! Accumulate miles driven to LEVEL UP and unlock even more cars, each with their own unique handling.

A race against time through the streets of the future!

 ===============================
 Features:
 - Unique In-Game Track Editor. A streamlined and extremely easy to use editor to make the most beautiful, winding city tracks with just a few touches!
 - Race against the clock to accumulate XP for LEVELLING UP
 - Dodge strange traffic of the future!
 - Pick up....PICK UPS!
 - Unlock cars, paintwork, buildings and license plates!
 - Custom 3D engine rendering outrageously awesome graphics of the FUTURE

Release date: OUT NOW!!!

Pricing: The app is Freemium, with in-game credits to buy.

Music: The music in the video is done by ZX82 with production by Static @ Unit 303. Both are UK Indies too support them by screaming their names!

Please use these links to keep up to date with news and other amusing thoughts:

http://www.supermono-studios.com/
